question: For positive numbers \(x\) and \(y\) the operation \(\spadesuit (x,y)\) is defined as \[\spadesuit (x,y) = x-\dfrac{1}{y}\] What is \(\spadesuit (2,\spadesuit (2,2))?\)
solution:
Evaluate the inner operation first by substituting into the given rule:
\[
\spadesuit(2,2)=2-\frac12=\frac32.
\]
This value is positive, so it is an allowed second input for the outer operation. Substituting again gives
\[
\spadesuit\left(2,\frac32\right)
=2-\frac{1}{3/2}
=2-\frac23
=\boxed{\frac43}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
